rows.text: The Group is dedicated to its sustainability goals, including the pledge to reach net zero carbon emissions by 2050.
rows.source_sentence: Our dedication to our sustainability goals, including the pledge to reach net zero carbon emissions by 2050, is also a strategic priority.

rows.text: SIA and Scoot have set an interim target of substituting 5% of our total fuel consumption with SAF by 2030.
rows.source_sentence: In this regard, SIA and Scoot have set an interim target of substituting 5% of our total fuel consumption with SAF by 2030, a significant milestone for the Group.

rows.text: The Group signed an agreement with Neste to purchase 1,000 tonnes of neat SAF.
rows.source_sentence: In May 2024, the Group signed an agreement with Neste to purchase 1,000 tonnes of neat SAF.

rows.text: SIA and Scoot’s flight emissions reported on CORSIA and EU/UK ETS platforms undergo external assurance by an accredited verifier.
rows.source_sentence: In compliance with the Carbon Offset and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) standards set by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), as well as the European Union and the United Kingdom’s Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS), SIA and Scoot’s flight emissions reported on these platforms undergo external assurance by an accredited verifier.

rows.text: SIA is a member of Star Alliance, IATA, IATA SEAC, AAPA, SAFUG, and SID, among other groups.
rows.source_sentence: SIA is a member of Star Alliance, the International Air Transport Association (IATA), the IATA Sustainability and Environment Advisory Council (SEAC), the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines (AAPA), the Sustainable Aviation Fuel Users Group (SAFUG), and the Singapore Institute of Directors (SID), among other groups.

rows.text: SIA and Scoot pledge to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2050.
rows.source_sentence: May 2021 SIA and Scoot pledge to achieve net zero carbon emissions by 2050.

rows.text: SIA is the first airline to sign the Global Sustainable Aviation Fuel declaration, committing to accelerate the development, production, and consumption of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).
rows.source_sentence: February 2022 SIA is the first airline to sign the Global Sustainable Aviation Fuel declaration, committing to accelerate the development, production, and consumption of Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF).

rows.text: SIA uplifts blended SAF onto SIA and Scoot flights departing from Singapore Changi Airport for the first time, as part of a 20-month pilot with CAAS and Temasek to operationalise the use of SAF in Singapore.
rows.source_sentence: July 2022 SIA uplifts blended SAF onto SIA and Scoot flights departing from Singapore Changi Airport for the first time, as part of a 20-month pilot with CAAS and Temasek to operationalise the use of SAF in Singapore.

rows.text: SIA and Scoot announce their target of replacing 5% of their total fuel requirements with SAF by 2030.
rows.source_sentence: November 2023 SIA and Scoot announce their target of replacing 5% of their total fuel requirements with SAF by 2030.

rows.text: The SIA Group signs an agreement with Neste to purchase 1,000 tonnes of neat SAF.
rows.source_sentence: May 2024 The SIA Group signs an agreement with Neste to purchase 1,000 tonnes of neat SAF.

rows.text: The Board steers the Management in ensuring that SIA’s long-term value creation is achieved with environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors as guiding principles at all times.
rows.source_sentence: It steers the Management in ensuring that SIA’s long-term value creation is achieved with environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors as guiding principles at all times.

rows.text: The SIA Group acknowledges the importance for Board members to have sufficient understanding of sustainability issues to effectively discharge their duties and carry out their role of sustainability governance.
rows.source_sentence: The SIA Group acknowledges the importance for Board members to have sufficient understanding of sustainability issues to effectively discharge their duties and carry out their role of sustainability governance.

rows.text: A short-term focus on economic gains may also impede longer-term efforts to decarbonise the hard-to-abate, emissions intensive sector.
rows.source_sentence: A short-term focus on economic gains may also impede longer-term efforts to decarbonise the hard-to-abate, emissions intensive sector.

rows.text: Enhancing SIA and Scoot’s fleet management can improve operational efficiencies and reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions into the environment.
rows.source_sentence: Enhancing SIA and Scoot’s fleet management can improve operational efficiencies and reduce greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions into the environment.

rows.text: However, over expansion or ineffective management of the operating fleet and network can lead to increased operational costs and higher overall carbon emissions from flights without delivering the expected socio-economic benefits.
rows.source_sentence: However, over expansion or ineffective management of the operating fleet and network can lead to increased operational costs and higher overall carbon emissions from flights without delivering the expected socio-economic benefits.

rows.text: Efforts to improve energy efficiency in its business operations will not only reduce overall emissions and support climate change mitigation efforts, but also promote the development of new job skills in sustainability roles.
rows.source_sentence: Efforts to improve energy efficiency in its business operations will not only reduce overall emissions and support climate change mitigation efforts, but also promote the development of new job skills in sustainability roles.

rows.text: Efforts to strengthen climate resilience bring about opportunities for job creation, as well as opportunities to adopt alternative low- carbon and resource-efficient technologies within the aviation sector.
rows.source_sentence: Efforts to strengthen climate resilience bring about opportunities for job creation, as well as opportunities to adopt alternative low- carbon and resource-efficient technologies within the aviation sector.

rows.text: On the contrary, the lack of adequate measures to manage the impact of extreme weather conditions and stresses could result in operational disruptions, as well as pose risks to the health and safety of aviation workers and travellers.
rows.source_sentence: On the contrary, the lack of adequate measures to manage the impact of extreme weather conditions and stresses could result in operational disruptions, as well as pose risks to the health and safety of aviation workers and travellers.

rows.text: Robust health, safety, and security standards in the aviation sector can reduce the risk of incidents and maintain stakeholders’ confidence.
rows.source_sentence: Robust health, safety, and security standards in the aviation sector can reduce the risk of incidents and maintain stakeholders’ confidence.

rows.text: If well managed, the occurrence and resulting fallout of incidents are minimised, resulting in greater confidence in flight safety as well as the industry and the airline’s integrity and ability to respond to incidents.
rows.source_sentence: If well managed, the occurrence and resulting fallout of incidents are minimised, resulting in greater confidence in flight safety as well as the industry and the airline’s integrity and ability to respond to incidents.

rows.text: If not properly managed, the occurrence of incidents could lead to injuries, loss of lives, and security breaches with widespread repercussions.
rows.source_sentence: If not properly managed, the occurrence of incidents could lead to injuries, loss of lives, and security breaches with widespread repercussions.

rows.text: This would ultimately result in negative perceptions of flight safety and security, and lead to a negative economic impact for the aviation industry.
rows.source_sentence: This would ultimately result in negative perceptions of flight safety and security, and lead to a negative economic impact for the aviation industry.

rows.text: The company likely prioritizes fuel efficiency through fleet renewal with newer, more fuel-efficient aircraft models and operational optimizations like route planning.
The company likely maintains positive labor relations through structured engagement with unions and crew, given its emphasis on employee welfare and community initiatives.
